implementation_plan:
Login to ADC-CH07 ,ADC-CH17 ,CSAUWRLS1 , CSAUWRLS2

1. Login into switch  CSAUWRLS1 , CSAUWRLS2 then take the running configuration of the switches and add device in maintenance window in SEVONE

2. Please run below commands to perform the pre checks on ADC-CH07 ,ADC-CH17 ,CSAUWRLS1 , CSAUWRLS2
         sh mac add 
	 sh int status 
	 sh ip arp 
	 sh cdp nei	
	 sh env power all 
	 sh inventory 
         sh run all
	 
3. Login into switch ADC-CH07 ,ADC-CH17  and shutdown the uplinks/mgmt towards  CSAUWRLS1 & CSAUWRLS2

int Eth1/17
shut
